title: 🤖 Unpatched AhsayCBS backup platform: attackers exploit one critical + one medium flaw to drop webshells and XMRig miners disguised as Micro
content_md:
🤖 Unpatched AhsayCBS backup platform: attackers exploit one critical + one medium flaw to drop webshells and XMRig miners disguised as Micro

via Mastodon https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/unpatched-ahsaycbs-flaws-exploited-to-deploy-webshells-mine-crypto/

CVE-2026-105133.evidence: BleepingComputer reports attackers exploiting an unpatched critical and a medium AhsayCBS flaw, named CVE-2026-105133 in the event, to deploy webshells and XMRig miners disguised as Microsoft binaries on unpatched backup servers.
